title: Rubio offers Japan FM condolences over murder linked to US Marine

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Saturday offered his “sincere condolences” to his Japanese counterpart over the murder in Okinawa allegedly committed by a US Marine, and pledged US cooperation in the investigation. A US Marine stationed on Okinawa has been arrested on suspicion of killing a 39-year-old woman at a hotel in the Japanese city of Naha and stealing her wallet. Local media have reported the woman was choked to death and that the Marine is denying the allegations.
